scientific_integrity: Infinite-domain inclusion follows from analytic spectral endpoint continuity and exact counting inequalities. Finite symbolic and numerical checks are supplementary. No independent external audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The explicit sufficient high-energy threshold may be far from sharp; the number and locations of lower spectral gaps are not determined. Scope is limited to two positive-width Dirichlet layers, a homogeneous perpendicular magnetic field and an ideal one-sided planar screen.
title: An explicit spectral half-line for a one-sided magnetic-layer interface
